journey.title: Tab away after typing an unavailable delivery date
journey.goal: Leaving the date field with Tab closes the calendar even when the typed date is outside the delivery window

steps.title: Type a date outside the delivery window

functionalJourney.title: Move the delivery into June with the pointer
functionalJourney.goal: Clicking through the calendar to June and choosing a day fills the delivery date

guards.title: Type a valid delivery date and Tab away
guards.goal: A correctly typed date is committed and the calendar closes when the user tabs away

plan.root_cause: The datepicker does not hide when the input loses focus via keyboard navigation (Tab) because there is no blur/focusout listener to hide the picker when focus moves to an element outside the picker.
plan.repair_strategy: Add a focusout event listener to the input field that hides the picker if the relatedTarget (the element gaining focus) is not inside the picker element, while in edit mode.

edits.before:
const onMousedownDocument = onClickOutside.bind(null, this);
      const listeners = [
        [inputField, 'keydown', onKeydown.bind(null, this)],
        [inputField, 'focus', onFocus.bind(null, this)],
        [inputField, 'mousedown', onMousedown.bind(null, this)],
        [inputField, 'click', onClickInput.bind(null, this)],
        [inputField, 'paste', onPaste.bind(null, this)],
        [document, 'mousedown', onMousedownDocument],
        [document, 'touchstart', onMousedownDocument],
        [window, 'resize', picker.place.bind(picker)]
      ];

plan.expected_accessibility_effect: The datepicker will now close when tabbing away from the input field, ensuring that keyboard users can move focus away without the datepicker obstructing other content.
functional_risks: Risk of hiding the picker too early if the focusout event fires when focus is moving to an element inside the picker (mitigated by checking relatedTarget).
Risk of double hiding if focusout fires multiple times (mitigated by checking editMode).
Potential interference with screen reader virtual cursors (mitigated by only hiding when focus moves outside the picker).
verification_requirements: Verify that typing a valid date and pressing Tab hides the datepicker.
Verify that typing an invalid date (outside allowed range) and pressing Tab hides the datepicker.
Verify that clicking on the datepicker does not hide it when focus moves to an element inside the picker (e.g., clicking a button in the datepicker).
Verify that clicking outside the datepicker hides it (existing behavior).
Verify that the datepicker still shows when the input gains focus.
